Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.pricing

Class KfeFeeQuoteResponse

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.pricing.KfeFeeQuoteResponse
public class KfeFeeQuoteResponse extends Object
Mutable JSON response carrying a fee quote bound to a user, wallet, destination, rail, and expiry. The signature allows downstream transaction submission to verify that quoted terms were not changed.
